figure_label.rationale: Whole figure pairs schematic heart drawings with each patient's own chest radiographs showing pacing leads; the radiographs are patient imaging data.
figure_label.override_reason: The default treats the mixed panels as other; each panel contains a patient chest radiograph (pixels viewed) beside a schematic drawing, so the figure is labelled clinical imaging.

label.rationale: Case 1 panel: grayscale chest radiograph(s) of pacing leads attributed to the matching local patient, shown beside a schematic heart drawing (pixels viewed).
label.override_reason: Default rule image_kind_mixed gives other; the radiograph portion is attributed patient imaging, so the panel is labelled clinical imaging.
